name: Trend Over Time
keywords: trend, time-series, line, growth, timeline, progress Line Chart
summary: Line Chart. Data has a time axis; user needs to observe rise/fall trends or rate of change over a continuous period

fields.whenToUse: Data has a time axis; user needs to observe rise/fall trends or rate of change over a continuous period
fields.whenNot: Fewer than 4 data points (use stat card); more than 6 series (visual noise); no time dimension exists
fields.colors: Primary: #0080FF. Multiple series: distinct colors + distinct line styles. Fill: 20% opacity
fields.accessibility: Differentiate series by line style (solid/dashed/dotted) not color alone. Add pattern overlays for colorblind users.
fields.fallback: Dashed/dotted lines per series; togglable data table with timestamps and values

name: Compare Categories
keywords: compare, categories, bar, comparison, ranking Bar Chart (Horizontal or Vertical)
summary: Bar Chart (Horizontal or Vertical). Comparing discrete categories by magnitude; ranking or ordering is the core insight; categories ≤ 15

fields.whenToUse: Comparing discrete categories by magnitude; ranking or ordering is the core insight; categories ≤ 15
fields.whenNot: Categories > 15 (use table or search); data has time dimension (use line); showing proportions (use waffle/stacked)
fields.colors: Each bar: distinct color. Grouped: same hue family. Always sort descending by value
fields.accessibility: Value labels on each bar by default. Sort control for user reordering.
fields.fallback: Value labels always visible; provide CSV export

name: Part-to-Whole
keywords: part-to-whole, pie, donut, percentage, proportion, share Pie Chart or Donut
summary: Pie Chart or Donut. ≤5 categories; one dominant segment vs rest; emphasis on visual proportion over exact values

fields.whenToUse: ≤5 categories; one dominant segment vs rest; emphasis on visual proportion over exact values
fields.whenNot: Categories > 5; slice differences < 5% (visually indistinguishable); user needs precise values; accessibility-first context
fields.colors: 5–6 max colors. Contrasting palette. Largest slice at 12 o'clock. Always label slices with %
fields.accessibility: Pie charts fail WCAG for colorblind users. Slices rely on color alone. Avoid as primary chart in a11y contexts.
fields.fallback: Must provide stacked bar alternative + percentage data table as mandatory fallback

name: Correlation / Distribution
keywords: correlation, distribution, scatter, relationship, pattern, cluster Scatter Plot or Bubble Chart
summary: Scatter Plot or Bubble Chart. Exploring relationship between two continuous variables; identifying clusters or outliers in a dataset

fields.whenToUse: Exploring relationship between two continuous variables; identifying clusters or outliers in a dataset
fields.whenNot: Variables are categorical (use grouped bar); fewer than 20 points (patterns aren't meaningful); mobile-primary context
fields.colors: Color axis: gradient (blue → red). Bubble size: relative to 3rd variable. Opacity: 0.6–0.8 to show density
fields.accessibility: Provide data table alternative. Combine color + shape distinction for colorblind users.
fields.fallback: Data table with correlation coefficient annotation; shape markers (circle/square/triangle) per group

name: Heatmap / Intensity
keywords: heatmap, heat-map, intensity, density, matrix, calendar Heat Map or Choropleth
summary: Heat Map or Choropleth. Showing intensity/density across a 2D grid; time-based patterns (e.g., activity by hour × day)

fields.whenToUse: Showing intensity/density across a 2D grid; time-based patterns (e.g., activity by hour × day)
fields.whenNot: Fewer than 20 cells (use bar); user needs to read exact values; colorblind users without pattern fallback
fields.colors: Gradient: Cool (blue) to Hot (red). Divergent scale for ±data. Always include numeric color legend
fields.accessibility: Pattern overlay for colorblind users. Numerical value on hover. Legend must include scale ticks.
fields.fallback: Numerical overlay on hover; downloadable grid table with row/column labels

name: Geographic Data
keywords: geographic, map, location, region, geo, spatial, choropleth Choropleth Map or Bubble Map
summary: Choropleth Map or Bubble Map. Data has a regional/location dimension; spatial distribution is the core insight for the user

fields.whenToUse: Data has a regional/location dimension; spatial distribution is the core insight for the user
fields.whenNot: Regions have very different sizes making visual comparison misleading (use bar); mobile-primary context
fields.colors: Single color gradient per region group. Categorized colors for discrete types. Legend with clear scale breaks
fields.accessibility: Include text labels for major regions. Provide keyboard navigation between regions.
fields.fallback: Region text labels; sortable data table by region name and value; keyboard-navigable regions

name: Funnel / Flow
keywords: funnel, flow, conversion, drop-off, pipeline, stages Funnel Chart or Sankey
summary: Funnel Chart or Sankey. Sequential multi-stage process; showing conversion or drop-off rates between defined stages

fields.whenToUse: Sequential multi-stage process; showing conversion or drop-off rates between defined stages
fields.whenNot: Stages aren't sequential; values don't decrease monotonically (use bar); fewer than 3 stages
fields.colors: Stages: single color gradient (start → end). Show conversion % between each stage. Highlight biggest drop
fields.accessibility: Explicit conversion % as text per stage. Stage labels always visible. Linear list view as fallback.
fields.fallback: Provide linear list view with stage name + count + drop-off %; keyboard traversal

name: Performance vs Target
keywords: performance, target, kpi, gauge, goal, threshold, progress Gauge Chart or Bullet Chart
summary: Gauge Chart or Bullet Chart. Single KPI measured against a defined target or threshold; dashboard summary context

fields.whenToUse: Single KPI measured against a defined target or threshold; dashboard summary context
fields.whenNot: No target or benchmark exists; comparing multiple KPIs at once (use bullet chart grid)
fields.colors: Performance: Red → Yellow → Green gradient. Target: marker line. Threshold zones clearly differentiated
fields.accessibility: Always show numerical value + % of target as text beside chart. Never rely on color position alone.
fields.fallback: Numerical value + % of target shown as visible text; ARIA live region for real-time updates

name: Time-Series Forecast
keywords: forecast, prediction, confidence, band, projection, estimate Line with Confidence Band
summary: Line with Confidence Band. Historical data + model predictions; communicating uncertainty range to non-technical stakeholders

fields.whenToUse: Historical data + model predictions; communicating uncertainty range to non-technical stakeholders
fields.whenNot: No historical baseline; prediction confidence is too low to be useful; audience is not data-literate
fields.colors: Actual: solid line #0080FF. Forecast: dashed #FF9500. Confidence band: 15% opacity fill same hue
fields.accessibility: Toggle between actual-only and forecast views. Legend must distinguish lines beyond color (solid vs dashed).
fields.fallback: Toggle actual/forecast independently; legend labels must include line-style description

name: Anomaly Detection
keywords: anomaly, outlier, spike, alert, detection, monitoring, deviation Line Chart with Highlights
summary: Line Chart with Highlights. Monitoring a time-series for outliers; alerting users to unexpected spikes or dips in operational data

fields.whenToUse: Monitoring a time-series for outliers; alerting users to unexpected spikes or dips in operational data
fields.whenNot: Anomalies are predefined categories (use bar with highlight); real-time context without a pause control
fields.colors: Normal: #0080FF solid line. Anomaly marker: #FF0000 circle + filled. Alert band: #FFF3CD background zone
fields.accessibility: Use shape marker (not color only) for anomaly points. Add text annotation per anomaly event.
fields.fallback: Text alert annotation per anomaly; anomaly summary list panel alongside chart

name: Hierarchical / Nested Data
keywords: hierarchy, nested, treemap, parent, children, breakdown, drill Treemap
summary: Treemap. Showing size relationships within a hierarchy; overview of proportional structure (e.g., budget breakdown)

fields.whenToUse: Showing size relationships within a hierarchy; overview of proportional structure (e.g., budget breakdown)
fields.whenNot: Hierarchy depth > 3 levels (too complex to read); user needs to compare sibling values precisely
fields.colors: Parent nodes: distinct hues. Children: lighter shades of same hue. White separator borders: 2–3px
fields.accessibility: Poor baseline accessibility. Always provide table alternative as primary view. Label all large areas.
fields.fallback: Collapsible tree table as primary view; treemap as supplementary visual only

name: Flow / Process Data
keywords: flow, process, sankey, distribution, source, target, transfer Sankey Diagram
summary: Sankey Diagram. Showing how quantities flow between nodes; multi-source multi-target distribution

fields.whenToUse: Showing how quantities flow between nodes; multi-source multi-target distribution
fields.whenNot: Flow directions form loops (use network graph); fewer than 3 source-target pairs; mobile-primary context
fields.colors: Gradient from source to target color. Flow opacity: 0.4–0.6. Node labels always visible
fields.accessibility: Structural flow charts cannot be conveyed by color alone. Provide flow table. Avoid on mobile.
fields.fallback: Flow table (Source → Target → Value); keyboard-traversable node list with tab stops

name: Cumulative Changes
keywords: waterfall, cumulative, variance, incremental, bridge, delta Waterfall Chart
summary: Waterfall Chart. Showing how individual positive/negative components add up to a final total (e.g., P&L, budget variance)

fields.whenToUse: Showing how individual positive/negative components add up to a final total (e.g., P&L, budget variance)
fields.whenNot: Changes are not additive; more than 12 bars (readability breaks); audience expects a simple total
fields.colors: Increases: #4CAF50. Decreases: #F44336. Start total: #2196F3. End total: #0D47A1. Running total line: dashed
fields.accessibility: Color + directional arrow icon per bar (not color alone). Labels on every bar.
fields.fallback: Table with running total column; directional arrow icons per row

name: Multi-Variable Comparison
keywords: radar, spider, multi-variable, attributes, dimensions, comparison Radar / Spider Chart
summary: Radar / Spider Chart. Comparing multiple entities across the same fixed set of attributes (e.g., product feature comparison)

fields.whenToUse: Comparing multiple entities across the same fixed set of attributes (e.g., product feature comparison)
fields.whenNot: Axes > 8 (unreadable); values need precise comparison (use grouped bar); audience unfamiliar with radar charts
fields.colors: Single dataset: #0080FF at 20% fill. Multiple: distinct hues with 30% fill. Border: full opacity
fields.accessibility: Limit axes to 5–8. Always provide grouped bar chart alternative for precise reading.
fields.fallback: Grouped bar chart as mandatory alternative; include raw data table

name: Stock / Trading OHLC
keywords: stock, trading, ohlc, candlestick, finance, price, volume Candlestick Chart
summary: Candlestick Chart. Financial time-series with Open/High/Low/Close data; trading or investment product context only

fields.whenToUse: Financial time-series with Open/High/Low/Close data; trading or investment product context only
fields.whenNot: Non-financial audience; no OHLC data available (use line chart); accessibility-first context
fields.colors: Bullish: #26A69A. Bearish: #EF5350. Volume bars: 40% opacity below. Body fill vs hollow for OHLC style
fields.accessibility: Provide OHLC data table. Colorblind: use fill vs outline pattern (bullish = filled, bearish = hollow).
fields.fallback: OHLC data table with sortable columns; numeric summary panel (daily change %)

name: Relationship / Connection Data
keywords: network, graph, nodes, edges, connections, relationships, force Network Graph
summary: Network Graph. Mapping connections between entities; network topology or social graph exploration context

fields.whenToUse: Mapping connections between entities; network topology or social graph exploration context
fields.whenNot: Node count > 500 without clustering pre-applied; user needs precise connection counts; mobile context
fields.colors: Node types: categorical colors. Edges: #90A4AE at 60% opacity. Highlight path: #F59E0B
fields.accessibility: Fundamentally inaccessible without alternative. Never use as sole representation. Always provide list alternative.
fields.fallback: Adjacency list table (Node A → Node B → Weight); hierarchical tree view when structure allows

name: Distribution / Statistical
keywords: distribution, statistical, spread, median, outlier, quartile, boxplot Box Plot
summary: Box Plot. Showing spread, median, and outliers of a dataset; comparing distributions across multiple groups

fields.whenToUse: Showing spread, median, and outliers of a dataset; comparing distributions across multiple groups
fields.whenNot: Fewer than 20 data points per group (distribution is not meaningful); audience unfamiliar with statistical charts
fields.colors: Box fill: #BBDEFB. Border: #1976D2. Median line: #D32F2F bold. Outlier dots: #F44336
fields.accessibility: Include stats summary table. Annotate outlier count in chart subtitle.
fields.fallback: Stats summary table (min / Q1 / median / Q3 / max / mean); outlier count annotation

name: Performance vs Target (Compact)
keywords: bullet, compact, kpi, dashboard, target, benchmark, range Bullet Chart
summary: Bullet Chart. Dashboard with multiple KPIs side by side; space-constrained contexts where a gauge is too large

fields.whenToUse: Dashboard with multiple KPIs side by side; space-constrained contexts where a gauge is too large
fields.whenNot: Single KPI with emphasis (use gauge); data has no defined target range; fewer than 3 KPIs
fields.colors: Qualitative ranges: #FFCDD2 / #FFF9C4 / #C8E6C9 (bad/ok/good). Performance bar: #1976D2. Target: black 3px marker
fields.accessibility: All values always visible as text. Color ranges are labeled with text thresholds not color alone.
fields.fallback: Numerical values always visible (not hover-only); color ranges labeled with threshold text

name: Proportional / Percentage
keywords: waffle, percentage, proportion, progress, filled, grid Waffle Chart
summary: Waffle Chart. Showing what fraction of a whole is filled; percentage progress in a visually engaging and accessible format

fields.whenToUse: Showing what fraction of a whole is filled; percentage progress in a visually engaging and accessible format
fields.whenNot: More than 5 categories (use stacked bar); exact values matter over visual proportion; very tight space
fields.colors: 3–5 categories max. 2–3px gap between cells. Each category a distinct accessible color pair
fields.accessibility: Better than pie for accessibility. Percentage text label always visible. Each cell has aria-label.
fields.fallback: Percentage text always visible; grid cells labeled with aria-label value; provide legend

name: Hierarchical Proportional
keywords: sunburst, hierarchy, nested, proportion, radial, circle Sunburst Chart
summary: Sunburst Chart. Exploring nested proportions where both hierarchy and relative size matter (e.g., org spend breakdown)

fields.whenToUse: Exploring nested proportions where both hierarchy and relative size matter (e.g., org spend breakdown)
fields.whenNot: More than 3 hierarchy levels (outer rings become unreadable); precision matters over overview; mobile
fields.colors: Center to outer: darker to lighter hue. Each level 15–20% lighter. Contrasting border between sectors
fields.accessibility: Poor accessibility beyond 2 levels. Mandatory table alternative required for any production use.
fields.fallback: Collapsible indented list with percentages; breadcrumb trail for current drill-down state

name: Root Cause Analysis
keywords: root cause, decomposition, tree, hierarchy, drill-down, ai-split, attribution Decomposition Tree
summary: Decomposition Tree. Decomposing a metric into contributing factors; AI-assisted analysis or BI drill-down scenarios

fields.whenToUse: Decomposing a metric into contributing factors; AI-assisted analysis or BI drill-down scenarios
fields.whenNot: No clear parent-child causal relationship; audience expects a summary rather than exploration
fields.colors: Positive impact nodes: #2563EB. Negative impact nodes: #EF4444. Neutral connectors: #94A3B8
fields.accessibility: Keyboard-navigable expand/collapse. Screen reader announces node value and % contribution.
fields.fallback: Keyboard expand/collapse tree; screen reader announces node label + value + % impact

name: 3D Spatial Data
keywords: 3d, spatial, immersive, terrain, molecular, volumetric, point-cloud 3D Scatter / Surface Plot
summary: 3D Scatter / Surface Plot. Scientific/engineering context where Z-axis carries essential info not expressible in 2D

fields.whenToUse: Scientific/engineering context where Z-axis carries essential info not expressible in 2D
fields.whenNot: 2D projection conveys the same insight; mobile context; accessibility-required environments; standard business dashboards
fields.colors: Depth cues: lighting and shading. Z-axis: color gradient (cool → warm). Transparent overlapping: opacity 0.4
fields.accessibility: 3D spatial charts are fundamentally inaccessible. Must not be used as primary chart type in any product UI.
fields.fallback: Mandatory 2D projection view + data table; do not use as primary chart type in product UI

name: Real-Time Streaming
keywords: streaming, real-time, ticker, live, velocity, pulse, monitoring Streaming Area Chart
summary: Streaming Area Chart. Live monitoring dashboards; IoT/ops data updating at ≥1 Hz; user needs current value at a glance

fields.whenToUse: Live monitoring dashboards; IoT/ops data updating at ≥1 Hz; user needs current value at a glance
fields.whenNot: Update frequency < 1/min (use periodic-refresh line chart); flashing content without reduced-motion support
fields.colors: Current pulse: #00FF00 (dark theme) or #0080FF (light theme). History: fading opacity. Grid: dark background
fields.accessibility: Pause/resume control required. Current value as large visible text KPI. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
fields.fallback: Pause/resume button required; current value shown as large text KPI; prefers-reduced-motion: freeze animation

name: Sentiment / Emotion
keywords: sentiment, emotion, nlp, opinion, feeling, text-analysis Word Cloud with Sentiment
summary: Word Cloud with Sentiment. NLP output visualization; exploratory analysis of text corpus sentiment; frequency-weighted keyword overview

fields.whenToUse: NLP output visualization; exploratory analysis of text corpus sentiment; frequency-weighted keyword overview
fields.whenNot: Precise values matter (word size is inherently imprecise); screen-reader context; corpus < 50 items
fields.colors: Positive: #22C55E. Negative: #EF4444. Neutral: #94A3B8. Word size maps to frequency
fields.accessibility: Word clouds fail screen readers. Never use as sole output of NLP analysis. Always pair with list view.
fields.fallback: Sortable list view by frequency with sentiment label column; word cloud as supplementary only

name: Process Mining
keywords: process, mining, variants, path, bottleneck, log, event Process Map / Graph
summary: Process Map / Graph. Analyzing event logs to visualize actual process flows; identifying bottlenecks and deviations in ops/product funnels

fields.whenToUse: Analyzing event logs to visualize actual process flows; identifying bottlenecks and deviations in ops/product funnels
fields.whenNot: No event log data available; audience expects a static flowchart (use diagram tool); node count > 100 without pre-filtering
fields.colors: Happy path: #10B981 thick line. Deviations: #F59E0B thin line. Bottleneck nodes: #EF4444 fill
fields.accessibility: Complex graphs are hard to navigate. Provide path summary text. Highlight top 3 bottlenecks as annotations.
fields.fallback: Path summary table (variant → frequency → avg duration); top 3 bottlenecks as text annotation panel
